title: Alternate Redrawn Mushroom, Fire Flower, P-Switch and Poison Mushroom
description:
Alternate Redrawn graphics meant for the Mushroom, Fire Flower, Blue and Silver P-Switches, and Thomas & Imamelia's Poison Mushroom Custom Sprite, based on their most modern designs.

Both the P-Switches and Poison Mushrooms come in 2 variations; the switches' bases can be either red-ish or blue/silver, while the Poison Mushroom can have a normal cap or one with a skull design.

Credit's not required, but heavily appreciated.
